templates.title: Commit templates
templates.description: Named output templates. The built-in 'Default' is always available and cannot be replaced; give your templates other names. Variables: {{type}}, {{scope}}, {{subject}}, {{body}}, {{changes}}, {{closes}}, {{skipCi}}, and {{header}} (type(scope): subject). A conditional section {{#body}}...{{/body}} is emitted only when that field is non-empty; any of the variables above can name a section, and a section can contain variables. Plain text outside variables is kept verbatim, so a footer is just a last line. Nested sections, loops and expressions are not supported; an invalid template falls back to Default and the notification says why.

defaultTemplate.title: Default template
defaultTemplate.description: Name of the template used to render the message. Blank or 'Default' uses the built-in Conventional Commits template. This Project value overrides the Global one; leave it blank in a project to inherit the global choice.
